title: 第四章 找到徐倩文
slug: 看见罪犯词条我成了警局团宠
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

死亡的恐惧笼罩在心头。

黎雾此刻明白，如果今日离开这个房间，他们将再也找不到任何和绑架案有关的线索。

甚至就连自己，因为牵扯到这件事里面，也极大可能殒命。

她还年轻，还没有活够。

她不想死。

强烈的情绪涌上心头，克服了心中的社恐。

此时周围人的议论声在她的脑海里全部成了背景音。

黎雾越过赵宇，自己抬步走进了屋内。

用普通的办法找不到徐倩文，那用她的眼睛呢？

既然人人头顶都有词条，那徐倩文的头顶上会有词条吗？

黎雾不知道，她只是想要试试。

站在房间正中央，黎雾抬眼，一寸一寸，一丝一毫，不敢有任何错漏，从那一堆堆的杂乱无序的东西上扫过。

赵宇看黎雾莫名其妙，不吭一声就又跑回到房间里，无奈叹了一口气：

“真是不知道你这小姑娘年纪轻轻的在想些什么。”

“刚刚这里我们都排查过了，没有任何问题。”

“难不成你还不相信我们不成。”

“走吧，”赵宇去拉黎雾的手臂，“我们先回去了。”

“不算你报假警，你别怕。”

看黎雾年纪轻轻脸都被吓白了，一副执着要找出线索的模样，赵宇无奈叹了口气。

心想算了，教育教育得了，也是他们昏了头听从了黎雾的话，总不好真的把她给抓起来关几天。

话音刚落，就听见黎雾惊喜的声音响起：

“我看到了！”

在一堆乱七八糟的杂物之中，黎雾眼也不眨，总算是捕捉到了【首富独女甲】的词条。

“徐倩文就在这里。”

黎雾一锤定音。

正在劝黎雾的赵宇顿时就懵了，下意识追问了一句：

“在哪里？”

“刚刚我们怎么没看到？”

房间就这么大，也没看到藏人的地方啊。

刀疤脸脸上得意的笑顿时僵在脸上，眼中闪过一丝慌乱。

围上来看热闹的邻居也被黎雾这突然开口的一句话给惊住了。

“什么，徐倩文就在这里？”

“真的假的，在哪里？”

“她是找人找疯了吧，大军这家里可没有藏人的地方。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The fear of death loomed in my mind.

Li Wu understood at this moment that if they left this room today, they would never find any clues related to the kidnapping case.

Even myself, because of being involved in this matter, is very likely to die.

She is still young and has not lived enough.

She doesn't want to die.

Strong emotions surged into my heart, overcoming the social fear in my heart.

At this time, the chatter of the people around her became the background sound in her mind.

Li Wu crossed Zhao Yu and walked into the house.

If you can't find Xu Qianwen with ordinary methods, what about using her eyes?

Since everyone has an entry on their head, will there be an entry on Xu Qianwen’s head?

Li Wu didn't know, she just wanted to try.

Standing in the center of the room, Li Wu raised his eyes and scanned the piles of messy things inch by inch, not daring to make any mistakes or omissions.

Seeing that Li Wu was confused, Zhao Yu ran back to the room without saying a word and sighed helplessly:

"I really don't know what you, a little girl, are thinking at such a young age."

"We have just checked here and there are no problems."

"Is it possible that you still don't believe us?"

"Let's go," Zhao Yu pulled Li Wu's arm, "Let's go back first."

"It doesn't count you reporting a false police report, don't be afraid."

Seeing that Li Wu's face was pale with fright at such a young age, and he looked so determined to find clues, Zhao Yu sighed helplessly.

I thought to myself, forget it, the education is enough, they were the ones who got confused and listened to Li Wu's words, it's hard to really arrest her and lock her up for a few days.

As soon as he finished speaking, he heard Li Wu's surprised voice:

"I saw it!"

Among the messy things, Li Wu finally caught the entry of "The Richest Man and Only Woman" without blinking an eye.

"Xu Qianwen is here."

Li Wu made the final decision.

Zhao Yu, who was trying to persuade Li Wu, was suddenly confused and subconsciously asked:

"Where?"

"Why didn't we see it just now?"

The room is so big, and there is no place to hide people.

The proud smile on Scarface's face suddenly froze, and a trace of panic flashed in his eyes.

The neighbors who gathered around to watch the excitement were also shocked by Li Wu's sudden words.

"What, Xu Qianwen is here?"

"Real or fake, where is it?"

"She must be looking for someone to go crazy. There is no place to hide people in Dajun's house."
